blocks.text: Transform your backyard into a tropical paradise with the Maxx Bubbles Tiki Torch Bubbler! Perfect for pool parties, outdoor celebrations, or a sunny afternoon in the backyard, this automatic bubble machine fills the air with a flurry of bubbles with just the flip of a switch. The bubbles are paired with upbeat tropical tunes to really get the party started! Designed to look like a tiki torch, the built-in LED light adds a touch of island magic, lighting up the night as bubbles float around. Standing 4 feet tall, it’s easy to set up and comes with ground stabilizers to keep it sturdy. Just connect the poles, fill the base with water or sand, and you’re ready to go! The convenient top fill design makes refilling bubble solution a breeze. Plus, the removable upper bubble unit doubles as a wand, so little ones can carry the bubble fun with them. With 4 ounces of premium, non toxic bubble solution included, you’ll be having a bubble party in no time!

items.label: NON-STOP BUBBLES and MUSIC
items.value: With the flip of a switch you can start the continuous stream of bubbles paired with upbeat tropical tunes to really get the party started!

items.label: MAGICAL GLOW
items.value: Built in LED light mimics a real tiki torch, adding a touch of island magic to any outdoor event whether at the pool, beach, backyard, park or any outdoor activity.

items.label: DUAL-USE BUBBLE WAND
items.value: The top of the tiki pole is removable, letting little ones run around with it like a bubble wand and create a whirlwind of bubbles wherever they go.

items.label: EASY ASSEMBLY
items.value: Stands 4 feet tall with ground stabilizers for stability; simply connect the poles, fill the base with water or sand, and you’re ready to go! Includes 4 ounces of bubble blast solution.

items.label: FUN FOR ALL AGES
items.value: Made from sturdy, non-toxic, child-safe materials, ensuring hours of play for kids, teens and adults. Includes 3.7V 1200mah rechargeable battery. Ages 3 and up. Please refer to the product image for battery charging and replacement instructions.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Tiki Torch and 4 oz Bubble Solution Refill

items.label: Item Dimensions L X W X H
